help: Select (S): Click to select, drag to move, drag empty space to box-select. For most editing. Shift adds to the selection.
title: Select

help: Pan (Space): Drag to move the view. When zoomed in. Hold Space to pan with any tool.
title: Pan

help: Measure (M): Drag between two points to read the distance. To check a crest against a hoop or a garment spot.
title: Measure

help: Open shape (1): Click to add points. Enter finishes. Double-click makes a curve point. For stems, borders and lines.
title: Open shape

help: Closed shape (2): Like Open shape, but the outline closes into a fill. For leaves, badge outlines and solid areas.
title: Closed shape

help: Circle (3): Drag a box for an ellipse. Hold Ctrl for a perfect circle. For round hat patches and dots.
title: Circle

help: Rectangle (4): Drag a box. Hold Ctrl for a square. For labels, bars and frames.
title: Rectangle

help: Pen (5): Draw freehand. Embroidery Studio smooths the line when you let go. For signatures and loose sketches.
title: Pen

help: Satin blocks (6): Click the left edge, then the right edge, and repeat along a column. For curved borders where you control each stitch angle.
title: Satin blocks

help: Text (T): Click where text goes, then type in the panel. For names, initials and monograms.
title: Text

help: Click to stitch (K): Click regions of a traced picture to stitch them. When you want to choose which parts get stitched.
title: Click to stitch

help: Manual stitch (7): Click to place each needle drop exactly. For small touch-ups.
title: Manual stitch
